description: §4.12.2 (S443, g-nested-program-auth-attr-silently-ignored) — `auth="required"` on a `<program>` nested inside `<program db>` fires E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH. `auth=` is not a nested-valid `<program>` attribute; before S443 it was silently dropped and the inner program's INSERT server function ran for anonymous callers (MEASURED S441: an anonymous POST wrote a row).
rationale: §4.12.2's nested-attribute table does not list `auth=`, and (S443) 'An `auth=` attribute on a nested `<program>` … SHALL be a compile error (`E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH`), whatever its value; the compiler SHALL NOT accept it silently.'
